name: Bird
overview: Scripture reveals that birds are part of God's created order, given life and sustenance by Him, as seen in Genesis where He commands the waters to bring forth flying creatures and grants them green herbs for food. Humanity is given dominion over birds, reflecting God's design for stewardship. The Bible also highlights God's providential care for birds, noting that He feeds them without their labor and values even the smallest sparrow, underscoring His intimate knowledge and care for all creation. Additionally, God's law commands respect for birds' nests, illustrating His concern for the protection of life.
